newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals end down, gold falls sharply.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals end down, gold falls sharply.

text.p: New York precious metals futures ended sharply lower Monday despite some late shortcovering, with gold bullion setting a fresh two-month low during the session.

"Fabricator demand for precious metals has remained weak even though summer is nearly over and investor demand remains weak especially from the Far East," Credit Suisse New York vice president Ian MacDonald said.
COMEX December gold ended down $1.60 at $387.20 an ounce after posting a three-year intraday low of $$385.80.
Estimated gold futures volume was 45,000 lots.
